manualSetup.title: Finish in Pelican
manualSetup.description: Kimono runs and publishes the unmodified Pelican panel. Pelican keeps its own installer, users, server templates, and node credentials.
steps: After the panel starts, open its /installer path and create the first administrator.
Keep a separate protected copy of the APP_KEY stored in Pelican's persistent data.
Create each node in Pelican, then install Wings on that machine with the configuration Pelican provides. Kimono does not provision or manage Wings nodes.
